source: house-style template A "They said I'd fail" (docs/house-style, after nateassets DcP_aC_AoQz); new characters and lines for fomo
note: Conflict line with a number at 0 s, the dare by 5 s, a cold low point held 2 s, the screens as the low point, the turn and the scale-up, a mirrored payoff under 8 words, a scream button, and 2 s of the real fomo screen to close. Each clip after a time jump opens on an insert.
input:
<brand>
Brand: fomo
Required screens. Every shot at one of these moments shows the matching screen, attached as a reference image and shown exactly:
- screen:1 "Home" (mobile, home) — required at: fomo-mention, app-open
- screen:2 "Token chart up" (mobile, trading, chart-up) — required at: trading, win
- screen:3 "Token chart down" (mobile, trading, chart-down) — required at: trading, loss
- screen:4 "Desktop trading" (desktop, trading) — required at: trading-desktop
Moments: app-open, fomo-mention, loss, trading, trading-desktop, win
</brand>
<cast>
char:1 Malik, 17, backwards navy cap, white tee
char:2 Aunt Tasha, his aunt, neat bob, cardigan
</cast>
<places>
place:1 Tasha's kitchen
place:2 Malik's small bedroom
</places>
<video_model>Seedance 2.5: 4–30 s per clip, up to 30 reference images (prefer 8 or fewer)</video_model>
<script>
1| SCENE 1 — INT. KITCHEN — DAY
2| Aunt Tasha slams Malik's empty piggy bank on the counter.
3| TASHA: Malik! Where's your five hundred dollars?
4| MALIK: I put it in fomo.
5| TASHA: A phone app? That's your college money!
6| MALIK: Give me one month.
7| TASHA: One month. Then you're bagging groceries.
8| SCENE 2 — INT. MALIK'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
9| ★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Malik's phone
10| Malik drops his head onto his arms in the blue phone glow.
11| MALIK: Come on. One more.
12| ★ fomo screen: Token chart up — fills the frame
13| Wordless montage: the same pose at his desk while the phone becomes a laptop, then a full trading desk.
14| ★ fomo screen: Desktop trading — on his monitor
15| SCENE 3 — INT. KITCHEN — DAY, ONE MONTH LATER
16| Malik slides his phone across the counter.
17| TASHA: That's… real?
18| MALIK: Still want me bagging groceries?
19| Tasha grabs his phone with both hands and screams.
20| ★ fomo screen: Home — closing tag, fills the frame
</script>

output.hook: Tasha bursts in and slams Malik's empty piggy bank down at 0 s, and the money ($500) is in her first line; his dare lands by second 5.

scenes.heading: INT. KITCHEN — DAY
scenes.look: Warm day interior: soft window key, warm bounce on faces, cool grey-blue walls; the red piggy bank is the one saturated object.

shots.speaker: Tasha
shots.line: Malik! Where's your five hundred dollars?
shots.action: Tasha slams the empty piggy bank on the counter.

shots.speaker: Tasha
shots.line: A phone app? That's your college money!
shots.action: Tasha jabs a finger at the phone.
shots.reaction: Brows crash into a hard V.

shots.speaker: Malik
shots.action: Malik steps in, nose to nose with her.
shots.camera: Profile two-shot, nose to nose, static

shots.speaker: Tasha
shots.line: One month. Then you're bagging groceries.

shots.camera: Extreme close-up on Malik's eyes, static

scenes.heading: INT. MALIK'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
scenes.look: Night screen-glow: cold blue phone light from below is the only key, the room near black, a warm tungsten doorway behind him; it warms as the chart turns green.

shots.action: The token falls on Malik's phone.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up on the phone, static

shots.action: Malik drops his head onto his arms.

shots.speaker: Malik
shots.action: Malik lifts his head and taps the screen.

shots.camera: Extreme close-up on the phone, static

shots.action: Same pose at the desk; the phone in his hands is now a laptop.
shots.camera: Medium shot, locked off, match cut

shots.action: Same pose; the laptop is now a wide desk with two monitors.
shots.camera: Medium shot, locked off, match cut

shots.action: The monitor shows the fomo desktop trading screen.
shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder close-up on the monitor, static

shots.action: Malik leans back in the green glow.

scenes.heading: INT. KITCHEN — DAY, ONE MONTH LATER
scenes.look: The same kitchen in golden-hour sun with a strong rim on both faces; warmer and richer than before.

shots.action: Malik's phone slides across the counter and stops in front of Tasha.
shots.camera: Overhead close-up on the phone, static

shots.speaker: Malik
shots.action: Malik leans on the counter, calm.
Tasha grabs the phone with both hands and screams.
shots.reaction: Mouth wide, eyes white all round.
shots.camera: Whip to an extreme close-up on Tasha's scream

shots.action: The real fomo home screen fills the frame.

clips.seam: Hard cut to his bedroom that night.
Hard cut to one month later.
